This first record won a Juno Award for Best Alternative Album and was highly rated in various international year-end critics polls, including by Rolling Stone, which significantly boosted attention for indie bands. "That first record mass romantic won a June War for Best Alternative Album."

Its success brought significant attention and momentum to the indie universe. "Their first album, Mass Romantic, came out on November 2000 on a label called Mint. That first record won the alternative Juno. It was also voted up high in a variety of international year end critics polls including Rolling Stone."
